name: claude-mods

plugins.name: deploy-verify
plugins.description: Verifies the live URL after a deploy command succeeds.

plugins.name: mini-offload
plugins.description: Routes heavy Bash commands to a second machine over ssh, syncing the commit first.

plugins.name: scope-guard
plugins.description: Stops a turn that has edited too many files until the goal is restated.

plugins.name: merge-gate
plugins.description: Denies a merge unless the latest human message says merge; ship, push and deploy do not count.

plugins.name: receipt
plugins.description: A receipt in the turn footer: edits, runs and curls, a warning when edits ran nothing, unfolded destructive commands, and a spinner that names an unverified claim.

plugins.name: diff-review
plugins.description: A docked pane with each edited file's hunk and keep or revert buttons that act without a model turn.

plugins.name: money-band
plugins.description: A money line above the prompt, read from SQLite databases over ssh.

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Limit windows, context fill and cost above the prompt, with a nudge to clear.

plugins.name: copy-band
plugins.description: Click-to-copy buttons above the prompt for the last answer's blocks, plus a durable stash.

plugins.name: chrome-switch
plugins.description: Switches the Chrome profile Claude drives with no approval click.

plugins.name: wod-band
plugins.description: A pixel Ragtag athlete above the prompt: every turn is a rep, the session is an AMRAP.

plugins.name: wod-timer
plugins.description: 3, 2, 1, GO on submit, a running clock per turn, and the split when it lands.

description: Mods that keep an agent honest, plus a few that make the terminal fun. Function-hooks plugins for Claude Code.
